about: At Phoenix Car Detailing & Accessories L.L.C, we don’t just work on cars – we protect, enhance, and transform them. From premium PPF and ceramic coating to 4×4 modifications and body kits, every service is delivered with precision and care.

Based in Ras Al Khor, Dubai, we specialize in professional car detailing, paint protection film, and premium body kits for Jetour and other Chinese SUV brands. Trusted by enthusiasts for quality, precision, and expert service.
